# apple_accessibility_declaration (Resource)

Declares the accessibility features an app supports on one device family, shown on its App Store page. A declaration replaced by a newer published one is created again. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_accessibility_declaration" "iphone" {
  app_id                  = data.apple_app.example.id
  device_family           = "IPHONE"
  supports_voiceover      = true
  supports_larger_text    = true
  supports_dark_interface = true
  publish                 = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `device_family` (String) Device family the declaration covers: `APPLE_TV`, `APPLE_WATCH`, `IPAD`, `IPHONE`, `MAC`, `VISION`.

### Optional

- `publish` (Boolean) Whether to publish the declaration on the App Store, replacing the device family's published declaration. Defaults to `false`, which keeps it a draft. A published declaration cannot be unpublished, so setting this back to `false` replaces it with a new draft.
- `supports_audio_descriptions` (Boolean) Whether the app supports this accessibility feature. Defaults to `false`.
- `supports_captions` (Boolean) Whether the app supports this accessibility feature. Defaults to `false`.
- `supports_dark_interface` (Boolean) Whether the app supports this accessibility feature. Defaults to `false`.
- `supports_differentiate_without_color_alone` (Boolean) Whether the app supports this accessibility feature. Defaults to `false`.
- `supports_larger_text` (Boolean) Whether the app supports this accessibility feature. Defaults to `false`.
- `supports_reduced_motion` (Boolean) Whether the app supports this accessibility feature. Defaults to `false`.
- `supports_sufficient_contrast` (Boolean) Whether the app supports this accessibility feature. Defaults to `false`.
- `supports_voice_control` (Boolean) Whether the app supports this accessibility feature. Defaults to `false`.
- `supports_voiceover` (Boolean) Whether the app supports this accessibility feature. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the declaration.
- `state` (String) `DRAFT` or `PUBLISHED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_accessibility_declaration.iphone
  identity = {
    id = "2b3c4d5e-6f70-4182-9a3b-4c5d6e7f8091"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the declaration.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_accessibility_declaration.iphone 2b3c4d5e-6f70-4182-9a3b-4c5d6e7f8091
```
